name: ReinforcedAverageStrategy (EMA8/21 + resampled SMA50 filter)
author: berlinguyinca collection (author not stated in file)
indicators: EMA8, EMA21, BB(20,2), SMA(50) on resampled (higher) timeframe
entry_long: EMA8 crosses above EMA21 AND close>resampled SMA50 AND volume>0
exit: EMA21 crosses above EMA8 AND volume>0
implementation_notes: Resample interval variable in source; lookahead check needed. Freqtrade note: minimal_roi/stoploss are part of the published strategy; ROI exits are time-since-entry based. Source file is the sole spec; no independent verification of results.
